pattern: {p:Player} discard[s] cards equal to the damage
subject: player

examples.text: Whenever ~ deals combat damage to a player, that player discards cards equal to the damage.
Whenever ~ deals damage to an opponent, that player discards cards equal to the damage.

counterExamples: Whenever ~ deals combat damage to a player, that player discards cards equal to the damage dealt this turn.
Whenever ~ deals combat damage to a player, that player discards cards equal to the damage at random.

pattern: if {c:FewerDiscarded} , {p:Player} draw[s] cards equal to the difference
subject: player

examples.text: Target player discards three cards. If fewer than three cards were discarded this way, you draw cards equal to the difference.
Target opponent discards four cards. If fewer than four cards were discarded this way, you draw cards equal to the difference.

counterExamples: Target player discards three cards. If fewer than three cards were discarded this way, you draw a card.
Target player discards three cards. If fewer than three cards were discarded this turn, you draw cards equal to the difference.

pattern: put ( a | an ) {f:Filter} card from among {g:Seen} into your hand and {r:Rest} into your graveyard
subject: none

examples.text: Reveal the top five cards of your library. Put a land card from among them into your hand and the rest into your graveyard.
Look at the top three cards of your library. Put an artifact card from among them into your hand and the rest into your graveyard.

counterExamples: Reveal the top five cards of your library. Put a land card from among them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
Reveal the top five cards of your library. You may put a land card from among them into your hand and the rest into your graveyard.
Reveal the top five cards of your library. Put two land cards from among them into your hand and the rest into your graveyard.

pattern: each {f:Filter} spell costs {m:ManaCost} more to cast for each {g:Filter} its controller controls

examples.text: Each creature spell costs {2} more to cast for each creature its controller controls.
Each enchantment spell costs {1} more to cast for each enchantment its controller controls.

counterExamples: Each creature spell costs {2} less to cast for each creature its controller controls.
Each creature spell costs {2} more to cast for each creature you control.
Each creature spell costs {2} more to cast.

pattern: enchanted permanent is an enchantment and loses all other card types

examples.text: Enchanted permanent is an enchantment and loses all other card types.
Enchanted permanent is an enchantment and loses all other card types. (It keeps its abilities.)

counterExamples: Enchanted permanent is an enchantment in addition to its other types.
Enchanted creature is an enchantment and loses all other card types.

pattern: create x 1/1 {s:Subtypes} creature tokens that are red , green , and white at the beginning of your next upkeep , where x is {q:Qty} at that time

counterExamples: When this creature enters, create X 1/1 Goblin creature tokens that are red, green, and white at the beginning of your next upkeep, where X is the number of creatures you control.
When this creature enters, create X 1/1 Goblin creature tokens that are red and green at the beginning of your next upkeep, where X is the number of creatures you control at that time.
When this creature enters, create X 1/1 Goblin creature tokens that are red, green, and white, where X is the number of creatures you control at that time.
